# The names a fresh browser window has before any page script runs (2026-11-20, BUG-331): every
# own and inherited property of a blank iframe's window in Chromium, lower-case names only (the
# interface constructors, Image, Event and so on, are left out), and the on* event handler
# properties left out too (scripts/tests/inline-script-web.test.js refuses /^on[a-z]+$/ itself).
# web/shared/safe-markup.js refuses a handler path that starts at a name the window had when it
# loaded, so a page function named like one of these could never be called from a handler: the
# test refuses such a handler root. Regenerate in a browser console with:
#   (()=>{const f=document.createElement('iframe');document.body.appendChild(f);const s=new Set();
#   for(let o=f.contentWindow;o;o=Object.getPrototypeOf(o))for(const n of Object.getOwnPropertyNames(o))s.add(n);
#   f.remove();return [...s].filter(n=>/^[a-z_$]/.test(n)&&!/^on[a-z]+$/.test(n)).sort().join(' ')})()
